nom: MAC Hyper Real Serumizer Eye Treatment

segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin, including one who was specifically recommended this for dry skin at a MAC counter, report it keeps the under-eye area hydrated all day without any oily residue.
segments.sensitive: Reviewers with sensitive skin, including two who say their skin cannot tolerate retinol, report no stinging, burning, or adverse reactions, and one whose sensitive eyes usually reject eye-area products says this is an exception that actually works for her.
segments.mature: Reviewers who mention their age, including ones in their 30s and 40s dealing with crow's feet or trying an eye cream for the first time, report brighter, more awake-looking under-eyes and reduced fine lines with regular use.
segments.combination: The one reviewer who identifies as combination, oily-T-zone skin reports loving the results from the whole Hyper Real line, including this eye treatment.

concerns.aging: Reviewers focused on fine lines and crepiness mostly report a visible softening with regular use, including several who specifically call out reduced crow's feet, crepiness, or fine lines at the corners of the eyes; one dissenting reviewer says she has not seen any change in her wrinkles yet after weeks of use.
concerns.dehydration: Nearly every reviewer who discusses hydration reports the treatment leaves the under-eye area noticeably softer and more hydrated, including several with naturally dry or dehydrated eye-area skin who say it keeps the area hydrated throughout the day without feeling greasy or heavy.
concerns.redness: Reviewers who mention irritation, including several with sensitive skin or sensitive eyes who say other eye products don't usually work for them, report no stinging, burning, or adverse reactions from this treatment.
concerns.spots: Most reviewers report the treatment visibly lightens or reduces the look of dark circles and discoloration, often within one to a few weeks of twice-daily use; but there is a substantial dissent, a large minority say they saw no real change in their dark circles despite continued use, and a few add that their dark circles come from hollowness or thin skin and veins rather than true pigmentation, which they think this treatment is better suited to target.
concerns.blemishes: The one reviewer who raises breakouts says heavier eye creams have caused her acne around the eyelids in the past, but this lightweight formula is gentle enough to wear there without issue.
concerns.oiliness: Reviewers who mention oiliness consistently say the formula absorbs quickly without any greasy, oily, or sticky residue, including the reviewer whose skin leans oily in the T-zone.

extraits.titre: Lose 20% of serum to the bottle
extraits.texte: Very disappointed that the bottle design means there is no way to get all of the serum out. I'd say there's at least 20% left that won't come out with the pump and will be difficult to get to due to the size and material of the bottle. Also didn't see much in terms of improvement of my dark undereye circles (used it 2x a day as recommended). Definitely not worth the price overall. Love the rest of the Hyper Real line, so very disappointed in the Eye Serum.

extraits.titre: Light & Hydrating but Not Effective for Brightening
extraits.texte: I did enjoy using this product for over a month now, but I don't think it is very effective at brightening the under eyes and is overpriced. It has a very light and hydrating texture, which makes it absorb easily & feel light/not greasy. The skin around my eyes feels hydrated and this does help lessen the appearance of the finer wrinkles. But I didn't see any change in the color/brightness of my eye bags. I asked my family and they didn't notice any either other than my under eyes having less wrinkles or being slightly smoother. The packaging is also quite large and unnecessary for such a small amount of product. Overall, I think this product is very underwhelming for the price. There are other products are much more effective for less. I received this product for free from Topbox Marketing for testing and review purposes.

I tried a sample of this by coincidence as I had originally gone shopping looking for a new foundation. I left the store not only with a new foundation, but also with samples from almost the entire Hyper Real line. The lady that was working the makeup counter recommended this for my dry skin and WOW - I am so happy to have asked her for help! I have tried several moisturizers in the past and never found one I loved.. until now. I just purchased the serumizer, serumizer eye, AND the moisturizer from this collection. It leaves my skin feeling weightless, no oily residue, and just a hint of splendid fragrance. LOVE IT!

I really like this eye serum. First off the packaging is super nice. It's really high quality and I love the pump top. The serum itself is like a light lotion texture. It goes on very smooth and is hydrating. It doesn't leave any sort of sticky or greasy residue after application and doesn't soak in too fast which I like. One of the biggest things that I like about it is that it has no fragrance at all (fragrance can be bad for skin so I'm glad it's fragrance free) and it doesn't bother my skin. I have skin that can be pretty sensitive. I never get rashes or break outs from products but it's not unusual for skincare to sting or burn a bit on my skin after application for a while, especially if my pores are open after a shower. This does not burn or sting my skin at all hallelujah! I've been usuing it every night for around 2 months now. I can't say I've seen a huge difference in under eye discoloration, but I believe mine to be from thin skin and veins as opposed to hyperpigmentation which I think this is more suited to tackle. I think it has really helped with hydrating my under eye area though as I have less dry skin there now so I really like it and plan on continuing to use it. Good job Mac! These are my fully honest opinions but as a Note: I received this product for free from Topbox Marketing for testing and review purposes.

MAC Hyper Real Serumizer Eye is an absolute godsend for my eyes! After hitting my 30s and having 2 kids, my eyes look tired on the daily. I'm beginning to have crows feet and those early signs of aging. This eye cream is so light, almost water-like when applying. It's consistency and texture make it perfect for wearing during the day under makeup, and for completely weightless skincare at night. I've found my eyes have become much brighter and my fine lines reducing. This is a truly luxurious product and I'm hooked! I received this product for free from Topbox Marketing for testing and review purposes.

I havent been using this product for this long so I cant say if it for sure helps under eye circles. I havent seen a difference in the dark circles under my eyes. But I think my dark circles are from hollowness not actual hyperpigmentation. So I use the eye treatment on other parts of my face that have dark marks. I have noticed those spots becoming more faint. I received this product for free from Topbox Marketing for testing and review purposes.

This is a great eye cream. I love that it contains both niacinamide and Vitamin C for extra brightening. I typically have quite sensitive eyes and alot of eye area products don't work well for me but thankfully Hyper Real Serumizer worked great for me. Since I started using this my eye area has become noticeably brighter and smoother. I highly recommend! I received this product for free from Topbox Marketing for testing and review purposes.
